title: odontostemma minimum
intro: Odontostemma minimum, commonly known as Small-flowered Tooth-cup, is a plant species in the family Plantaginaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to reduce inflammation and protect against oxidative stress. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a potential treatment for various infections and inflammatory conditions. The bioactive constituents of Odontostemma minimum include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
